queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE (name LIKE 'Burp Suite 2%' OR name LIKE 'Burp Suite Professional %' OR name LIKE 'Burp Suite Community Edition %') AND publisher = 'PortSwigger Web Security';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE ((name LIKE 'Burp Suite 2%' OR name LIKE 'Burp Suite Professional %' OR name LIKE 'Burp Suite Community Edition %') AND publisher = 'PortSwigger Web Security') AND version_compare(version, '2026.10.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('burpsuite.exe','burpsuitepro.exe','burpsuitecommunity.exe'));
